paragraphs: R' Eliezer ben Shemaiah: [Tosefta Parah, chapter 9](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Parah.10.2).

notes.text: The linked Tosefta’s Hebrew names Rabbi Eliezer ben Shemaiah of Kefar Otnai, as does [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=504&lang=en). The episode is numbered 10:2 in the linked edition. Its English translation follows a reading that names Shemaiah himself.

Shabbat gives Rav Yosef son of Rabbi Shemaiah as an alternative attribution to Rabbi Guryon, and [Heilprin’s Rav Yosef entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2030&lang=en) cites this folio. Buber’s Tanchuma, Vayigash 6:1, gives Rabbi Yirmeyah ben Shemaiah. These three notices leave open whether the fathers were the same person.
